candidateRules.trigger: The most recent valid observations are not_demonstrated or partially_demonstrated.
All evidence for the competency comes from one scenario or one group.
The evidence is dominated by FULL assistance responses.
A recommended prerequisite competency is weaker than a competency that depends on it.
Previously secure evidence falls outside the approved recency window.
The learner explicitly asked to review the competency or objective.

prioritization.rule: When more than one scenario can test the same competency, prefer a scenario the learner has not already used for it.

recencyPolicy.note: The recency window is a numeric policy value that is deliberately absent until Product Owner and specialist approval.
